title: flywheel: orch_approve_beads input
description: [DEPRECATED — use flywheel_approve_beads instead; removed in v4.0] Review and approve bead graph before implementation. Reads beads from br CLI, computes convergence, and acts based on action parameter. Call after creating beads with br create.

action.description: start=approve and launch implementation, polish=refine beads/plan, reject=stop, advanced=use advancedAction, git-diff-review=run git-diff style plan review cycle, remediate=create one bead from a failing outcome-grading criterion (T20), converge-polish=run one round of the polish convergence loop, verify-bead=independently verify one bead's completion report (needs beadId).

beadId.description: Required when action=verify-bead: the bead whose completion report to verify.

coordinatorName.description: Agent Mail identity that receives implementer start/done messages when action=start.

includePi.description: Optional Pi lane opt-in when action=start. When true and agy is available, splits beads 1:1:1 across Claude, Pi, and AGY (cc:pi:agy) instead of the default 1:1 Claude + AGY (cc:agy) split.

advancedAction.description: Required when action=advanced. Selects the advanced refinement strategy.

remediation.description: Required when action=remediate. Carries the failing-criterion payload used by the §"Remediation Bead Template" body. T11 (_wrapup.md Step 9.5 Iterate) renders this from the failing PerCriterionVerdict + rubric.md.

planSlug.description: Plan slug used to fill the verdict-file path in the bead body.

evidence.description: Grader's evidence trace; quoted into the bead body unchanged.

gaps.description: Gaps the grader flagged; rendered as bullet list in bead body.

until_convergence_score.description: Optional polish-bound (default 0.85). When action=polish and the in-state convergence score has already crossed this threshold, the call returns stop_reason="convergence_reached" instead of scheduling another polish round (bead 2p5).

max_rounds.description: Optional polish-bound (default 5). When action=polish and state.polishRound >= max_rounds, the call returns stop_reason="max_rounds_hit" instead of scheduling another polish round (bead 2p5).
